matter_title: State & Apex FinTech Ltd. vs. Zenith Cloud Technologies Pvt. Ltd.

gold_events.description: Execution of Master Software Escrow and License Agreement between Apex FinTech and Zenith Cloud.
Alleged completion of Milestone 2 and submission of security audit certificate #CG-8829 by Zenith Cloud.
Formal legal demand notice issued by Singhania & Partners demanding escrow reconciliation within 15 days.
Escrow negotiation meeting at Zenith headquarters resulting in heated dispute.
Registration of FIR No. 0412/2024 at PS Mandir Marg under Sections 406/420/468/471/120-B IPC.
Police seizure of executive laptop and office hard drives without civilian panchas.
Section 161 CrPC witness statement recorded for CFO Ramesh Gupta clarifying absence of assault.
Section 482 CrPC quashing petition filed before the Hon'ble Delhi High Court.
